statements.t: Management also continues to focus on realigning operating costs, through efficiencies, internal AI deployments, and targeted spending cuts.
Combined with continued efforts to expand our market reach, we expect to deliver revenue growth through end market diversification and an enhanced consultative sales process.

Subsequent to the end of the third quarter, on October 20, 2026, we completed the stock acquisition of V-Tek, Inc. and A&J Programming, Inc., which we expect will diversify the Company’s customer base and sectoral exposure, enhance manufacturing capabilities and efficiencies, and accelerate our move into programming and Programming-as-a-Service (“PaaS”).
We expect continuously to review our global operations with an eye to improving operational efficiency and effectiveness worldwide.

The decrease is due primarily to a reduction in expenses related to headcount and to outside services for projects completed in 2025 though the Company continues to make selected investments in its core platform and software technologies and offerings.
Although we have no significant capital expenditure plans currently, we expect to continue to carefully make and manage expenditures to support the business.
Engineering and production tooling, test equipment and sales demonstration products will continue to be purchased as we develop and release new products.
We have tried to balance our spending with our anticipated revenue levels and the goal of profitable operations.
The Company is also considering alternative billing structures which may reduce ongoing working capital needs.
We believe that we have sufficient cash or working capital available under our operating plan to fund our operations and capital requirements through the next one-year period, and beyond.

Our working capital may be used to fund possible losses, business growth, project initiatives, share repurchases and business development initiatives, including acquisitions, which could reduce our liquidity and result in a requirement for additional cash before that time.
Over the last two years we have used AI to optimize the business, and we will apply AI to the integration and ongoing operations at V-TEK.
We will follow our mandate of best people and best practices.
V-TEK’s existing programming business, A&J Programming, accelerates our strategic plan to provide Programming-as-a-Service.

“Data I/O will remain focused on optimizing the business, using technology and realigning costs to our new go-to-market strategy, and we continue to review expense reductions that will improve profitability.

Bookings through the first six months of the year are indicative of the current market for programmable devices which has been accelerating within end markets not traditionally targeted by the Company, including edge AI and robotics.
